anomalies.observed: The isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 have both GND1 and GND2 pins connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: An isolated CAN transceiver must keep its logic-side ground (GND1) and bus-side ground (GND2) separate; the specification states the CAN buses are isolated.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)

anomalies.impact: CAN isolation is defeated; the CAN bus side shares the board ground and loses the intended common-mode/noise protection.

anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23; it is not connected to +3V3 or any driver.
anomalies.expected: Active-low status/Ethernet LEDs need their common anode connected to a supply (e.g. +3V3) so the sink outputs can light them.
anomalies.impact: The LEDs on this net cannot light, so the associated Ethernet/activity indication is missing.

anomalies.observed: There is no ESTOP_SINK2 net; J13 pin 1 and pin 6 are both connected to ESTOP_OUT, while the only external sink nets present are ESTOP_SINK1 and ESTOP_SINK_LOCAL.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes an e-stop loop with separate ESTOP_SINK1, ESTOP_SINK2, and ESTOP_SINK_LOCAL sink points.

evidence.quote: an e-stop loop with multiple sink points (`ESTOP_SINK1`, `ESTOP_SINK2`, `ESTOP_SINK_LOCAL`) gated through single non-inverting buffers (`SN74LVC1G07`, parts `U15`, `U22`, `U35`, `U36`) wired as `/OE`-controlled sinks

anomalies.impact: The second remote e-stop sink point is missing or merged into ESTOP_OUT, potentially breaking the intended e-stop loop for one connector.

parsed.summary: The build contains a clear isolation violation on the CAN transceivers, plus an unpowered LED net and a missing/merged e-stop sink point relative to the specification.
